tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Find menu items by a few words (a filling, a pastry, 'vegan', 'ube'), across today's counter menu and catering. Each match comes with its price, a short description, a photo URL and the allergens the bakery lists. Custom cakes are not in it; they are designed with cake_options.

tools.name: show_item
